evidence.title: Galaxy Completes Phase I of Its Helios Data Center Campus, Delivering 133 Megawatts of Critical IT Load to CoreWeave
evidence.excerpt: Galaxy reports that greenfield development is underway on the 260 MW critical-IT Phase II build at Helios, with civil and structural work advancing and deliveries forecast to begin in the first half of 2027.

The header capture includes a response cookie, and the full curl facts include endpoint, certificate, and local-network telemetry; this derived record retains only artifact hashes and a narrow set of non-sensitive response facts.

metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: The evidence retrieved_at uses the response HTTP Date at whole-second UTC precision. Exact local capture-artifact modification times were 2026-07-20T07:55:02Z and are retained only in the focused verification test; neither timestamp is treated as publication time.
metadata.canonical_url_basis: The zero-redirect requested and effective URLs are byte-identical and match the HTML canonical URL.
metadata.construction_scope: The disclosure directly says greenfield development is underway on the Phase II build and that civil and structural work are advancing. This supports one generic under_construction lifecycle observation for Phase II. It does not isolate excavation, foundations, structural frame, shell, MEP, energization, commissioning, completion, occupancy, or operation sufficiently to normalize a narrower stage.
metadata.phase_scope_guardrail: This record represents Phase II only. Phase I is reported complete and revenue-generating, while Phase III appears only inside cross-phase commitments. Neither creates an additional entity, lifecycle observation, or normalized capacity row in this narrow source record.
metadata.capacity_scope: The 260 MW value is explicitly Phase II critical IT capacity. Galaxy also says CoreWeave has committed across Phases I through III under 15-year leases, so the row is normalized as contracted critical_it_mw for the Phase II project.
metadata.capacity_nonaggregation_guardrail: Phase I's 200 MW gross and 133 MW critical-IT figures, the 526 MW cross-phase committed critical-IT figure, and the 800 MW cross-phase gross-power figure all include scopes outside Phase II and remain metadata. The 1.63 GW approved campus power and potential 3.6 GW campus power are not typed as grid connection, gross facility demand, critical IT, generation nameplate, current load, or measured consumption and remain metadata. None is added to the normalized 260 MW row.
metadata.delivery_guardrail: First-half 2027 data-hall deliveries are a forward-looking range, not an actual milestone or exact target date. They create no completion, operational, occupancy, energization, commissioning, current-load, or target-date assertion.
metadata.operating_model_scope: CoreWeave's cross-phase commitment under 15-year leases includes Phase II and supports one project-level hyperscale_lease observation. The lease does not establish current occupancy or operation for Phase II.
metadata.workload_scope: The disclosure characterizes the development as hyperscale AI data-center infrastructure and Phase II is within the CoreWeave lease scope. This supports only ai_specialized_unspecified for the future Phase II project. It does not establish AI training, AI inference, HPC, installed accelerators, model identity, rack density, utilization, or current compute activity.
metadata.role_scope: Galaxy explicitly describes itself as developing and operating data-center infrastructure and as an operator executing the Helios development. CoreWeave is explicitly the lease counterparty across Phases I through III. These statements support Galaxy as developer and operator and CoreWeave as Phase II tenant; they do not establish a separate owner, landlord, utility, contractor, investor, customer, or user role.
metadata.location_scope: The disclosure locates Helios only in West Texas. No city, county, street address, parcel, boundary, unique-site proof, normalized coordinate, or geometry is retained.
metadata.site_resolution_guardrail: The named campus and phase identify one logical campus and one project, but the disclosure does not prove parcel topology, building count, data-hall count, or a uniquely geolocated physical site. unique_site_counted remains false in downstream projections unless independently resolved.
metadata.energy_guardrail: No current electrical load for Phase II, annual energy consumption, measured consumption, generation nameplate, PUE, WUE, renewable share, water use, cooling system, or emissions observation is created. MW power and MW critical IT are not converted into MWh or annual energy.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Publisher imagery, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, and analyst geolocation contribute nothing to identity, lifecycle, capacity, classification, roles, coordinates, geometry, or site resolution in this record.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from a public all-rights-reserved company disclosure; captured response bytes, response headers, curl telemetry, and publisher media are not redistributed.
